Titles are a feature in the game which allow players to have a title above their head. 

== Current Titles: ==
----Event titles:
----
*'''[Frozen]''' - Obtained by completing Tiers 10 of Frozen portal during Christmas 2022 update part 2.
* '''[Devil Hunter]''' - Obtained by getting over 1000 Gun Devil Bullets during the Devil City Event.
* '''[Fool]''' - Obtained by completing Tier 10 Devil Academy portal during update 12.
* '''[Wishful]''' - Obtained by completing Tier 10 Witch City portal during the update 13.5.
* '''[Holy Quintet]''' - Obtained by obtaining and evolving all 5 units from the Update 13.5.
* '''[Sunny]''' - Obtained by completing Tier 10 Summer portal during Update 15.5.
* '''[Overlord]''' - Obtained by obtaining and evolving all 6 units from the Update 16
* '''[Noble]'''  - Obtained by obtaining and evolving all 6 units from the Update 17.0.
*'''[Detective]''' - Obtained by obtaining and evolving all 5 units from the Update 17.5.
*'''[Spooky]''' - Obtained by completing wave 50 on Nightmare Hunt during Halloween 2023 or Christmas 2024.
*'''[Unholy]''' - Be an original owner of Dracula.
*'''[Festive]''' - Obtained by completing wave 50 on Holiday Hunt during Christmas 2024.
*'''[Enlightened]''' - Be an original owner of Enlightened.
*'''[Transcended]''' - Be an original owner of Illusionist (Transcended).
*'''[Assassin]''' - Obtained by obtaining and evolving all 4 event units during Update 19.5.
----Ranking titles: 
----
*'''[Tournament # Champion]''' - Obtained by being Rank #1 in your weekly tournament bracket when it ends. ( # is specific to weekly tournament number)
*'''[Top 50 Infinity Castle Upd #]''' - Obtained by placing in the top 50 at the end of Infinity Castle leaderboard. ( # is specific to update number)
* '''[Top 25 Infinity Castle Upd #]''' - Obtained by placing in the top 25 at the end of Infinity Castle leaderboard. ( # is specific to update number)
* '''[Top 10 Infinity Castle Upd #]''' - Obtained by placing in the top 10 at the end of Infinity Castle leaderboard. ( # is specific to update number)

* '''[Top 50 Upd #]''' - Obtained by placing in the top 50 at the end of any infinite leaderboard. ( # is specific to update number)

* '''[Top 25 Upd #]''' - Obtained by placing in the top 25 at the end of any infinite leaderboard. ( # is specific to update number

* '''[Top 10 Upd #]''' - Obtained by placing in the top 10 at the end of any infinite leaderboard. ( # is specific to update number)
----Other titles: 
----
*'''[Content Creator]''' - Obtained by having the "Content Creator" role in the [https://discord.com/invite/adventures Official Discord].
*'''[Moderator]''' - Obtained by having the "Moderator" role in the [https://discord.com/invite/adventures Official Discord].
*'''[Admin]''' - Obtained by having the "Administrator" role in the [https://discord.com/invite/adventures Official Discord].
*'''[Tester]''' - By being a game tester
*'''[OG]''' - Playing the game before re-release (before UPD 19)
*
